_comment: Workbook exercise air-maintenance (docs/workbook/air-maintenance.md): a dirty filter and a hunting cooling valve on the synthetic-ahu-maintenance units (generated by CAMBER, no real building), at the trend's own 5-minute resolution and the rules' defaults: filter_fouling warns when the run's median filter DP reaches 1.0 in. w.c. and faults at 1.5; control_hunting warns at 6 and faults at 12 valve reversals an hour. The variants air-maintenance--lastweek (filter_fouling on the second week only), air-maintenance--10min and air-maintenance--15min (control_hunting on the same data resampled) run one rule each.
